attributes.additional_details: This Government has no excuse to continue without requesting the consent of the people. Both the Government and the country have seen a spiralling crisis of chaos over the last two years despite being elected with a massive majority in the House of Commons. The resignation of the Prime Minister today confirms that mandate has been broken beyond repair. Without a new election there can be no legitimacy to the remaining tenure of this Labour Government.
